title: Saving your game
summary: The game saves itself every few seconds. Save in the menu keeps a copy of your own.
text:
Your colony **autosaves** to this browser every few seconds and whenever you leave the page, so you can close the tab and pick up again with CONTINUE on the title screen.

The menu's **Save** (or Ctrl+S) also keeps a copy of your own, and **Load** brings back that copy.

- Each region you play keeps its own save, so your home colony and an expedition never overwrite each other
- Saves live in this browser only: another browser or device starts fresh
- NEW GAME starts the whole campaign over and clears the autosaves (your own Save copy stays)
